data.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
data.summary_raw: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

data.title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
data.summary_raw: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

data.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
data.summary_raw: Fortitude secured priority access to BITMAIN’s next-generation Zcash miners as it expands capacity and increases financing from DCG.

data.title: Rep. Don Davis introduces bill to stop federal candidates trading prediction market contracts tied to their own elections
data.summary_raw: Don Davis introduced legislation barring federal candidates and their families from trading prediction contracts tied to their own elections.
